title: Exceptional Tour - Best EVER!!
text: Not one to write reviews often, but if I could give Sailing Experience Barcelona (SEB) 10 Stars, I would!  Can’t say enough about the Bike, Winery & Sailing tour - I was so excited for it and beyond thrilled when it so far exceeded my expectations!  As it turned out, I was the only participant, which was an incredible treat!  Often in those situations the Operator will cancel or try to reschedule the tour, but not SEB. author: T8086LYlisac

title: Exceptional day
text:
We were a small group so Lionel was able to provide a remarkable experience by answering all our questions.  The ride was easy, mostly flat with good warnings when we were heading into areas of hills.  The wine tour was very enjoyable with are very experienced guide (Francesca?) who explained the history, the area, and the grape types very well.  We did have tapas included which was flavorful.  
We finished with a sailing return to the port which made the day a superior experience.  Our captain was very knowledgable and handled the boat very well.

author: Joke_P

title: This was an amazing...
text: This was an amazing experience from start to finish.  E-bike ride was approx 11 miles , mostly flat/occasional hills that were manageable with the e-bike and beautiful ocean views.  Winery was gorgeous and wine and snacks were delicious.  Boat ride along the coast was also lovely and snacks and drinks were served on board as well. Everything was smoothly coordinated  This was one of the highlights of our trip to Barcelona - I highly recommend!
author: Theresa_C

title: E-bike Vino and Sail
text: It was superb. Great guide Robin and boat captain Marcelo. Fun e bike ride, very god winery and staff Susana and sail back to Barcelona.
author: B9758SMlees

title: 60th Birthday Celebration
text: This was a fun filled day. An easy e-bike ride along the coast to the beautiful winery & a leisurely sail back to Barcelona.
author: James_B

title: Highlight of Our Trip
text: This was one of the highlights of our trip! The guide was very patient on the bikes, the family owned winery was so relaxing, and the boat as amazing at sunset! Would do again 1000%
author: Julia_B

title: Highlight of my trip
text: The e-bike ride was a little less flat / easy than I expected, but also way more beautiful- mostly up the ocean / beach.  The wine tour was wonderful, and the sail boat ride back was amazing.  Highlight of my trip.
author: Laura_R

title: Amazing day tasting wine and sailing!
text: From car ride with Valentin to the Winery tour and finishing the day with sailing with Marchello! Amazing experience!
author: rvashi

title: Wonderful day in Barcelona!
text: Although we started out wanting the ebike portion of tour, it quickly changed and we were accommodated with a ride in a van to the winery. The winery was beautiful. Situated on top of a hill overlooking Allela. Annette our hostess was very knowledgeable and pointed out things I nevr heard before. We sampled 4 wines and had snacks. Then time to go sailing. Sailing was amazing! The experience was well worth it. Thank you Lionel, Valetine, Marchello for a great day!
author: CHRISTINE_G

title: A fabulous trip!
text: Such a great half-day! The e-bikes made the cycling a breeze & the route along the coast with our knowledgable host was both interesting and picturesque. The vineyard visit was the highlight; tasting some lovely organic wines from a small local producer, along with local appetisers & with a narrative and tour provided by our engaging hostess. Then sailing back on a yacht, beer, cava, sangria or a soft drink in hand. The perfect end to a super afternoon. Would thoroughly recommend!
author: MerryJobson
